name: ZeroErr
name_zh: 零差云控（深圳）科技股份有限公司
summary: ZeroErr is a Shenzhen-based robotics component manufacturer. It develops eRob integrated rotary joint actuators, eCoder magnetic absolute encoders and dedicated power, communication and commissioning hardware for robot builders. Its products are used in collaborative, surgical, humanoid and industrial automation systems; complete robots shown in applications may belong to customer manufacturers.
